text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah reaffirms desire to boost ties with Egypt.
- Acting Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah receives message from Bahrian's Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammad bin Mubarak al-Khalifa.

- Government panel in charge of illegal residents' affairs met on Monday to discuss nationality applications. About 110,000 stateless people, mainly Arabs, live in Kuwait and claim the Kuwaiti nationality.
- Five Iraqis exchange fire with Kuwaiti border police.
- Kuwait Finance House to announce bi-annual results next week.
- Arab League briefs Kuwait on efforts to solve POWs' issue. Kuwait says Iraq still holds about 600 Kuwaiti nationals since its 1990-91 occupation of the Gulf Arab country. Iraq denies
- Islamic banking is becoming popular in Kuwait for its convenience, bankers say.
- Data not available for any cancer link to the 1991 Gulf War, health sources say.
- Emir receives honour-listed high school students.
